rationale: Algeria is published on a never-assessed uniform seed vector (2/2/2/1.5/2/1.5/2/1.5, composite 20.3) shared byte-identically by twelve countries at ranks 134-145. This full 40-subdimension assessment replaces the seed with evidence and returns 11.2, a difference of -9.1 points. The band moves from Developing to Critical.

band_change_evidence_test.required: at least 2 independent sources, at least 1 at sourceTier >= 4

evidence.quote: Algerian authorities continued to implement arbitrary travel bans to silence perceived critics, including activists, journalists, trade unionists, and academics, which can be imposed without formal notice, are often unlimited in duration, and are almost impossible to challenge.

The Algerian authorities must immediately and unconditionally release all arbitrarily detained journalists targeted for exercising their right to freedom of expression, including Abdelwakil Blamm, Hassan Bouras and Christophe Gleizes.
On 12th November 2025, President Abdelmadjid Tebboune pardoned Franco-Algerian writer Boualem Sansal, who had been detained since November 2024.
